name: mongo-compass
description: Explore MongoDB, edit documents, build aggregation pipelines, manage indexes and schemas — and deploy and operate replica sets and sharded clusters on Docker, local processes, Kubernetes or Atlas without leaving VS Code.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Database connections and data-changing commands require a trusted workspace.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Run MongoDB in Docker, as local processes, on Kubernetes (Percona / MongoDB operator or a StatefulSet) or in Atlas — and manage it from here.
[New Deployment](command:mongoCompass.deploy.create)
[Attach Kubernetes Deployment](command:mongoCompass.deploy.attachKubernetes)
[Import Atlas Clusters](command:mongoCompass.deploy.importAtlas)
Connect to a replica set or sharded cluster to see its topology, members, shards and routers.

commands.title: Member Settings (Priority, Votes, Hidden, Delay, Tags)…

view/item/context.when: view == mongoCompass.explorer && (viewItem == collection || viewItem == collection.view || viewItem == collection.timeseries)

mongoCompass.defaultLimit.description: Default page size (limit) used by the documents view and query bar.

mongoCompass.maxTimeMS.description: Maximum time in milliseconds the server should spend on a query or aggregation.

mongoCompass.schemaSampleSize.description: Number of documents sampled when analyzing a collection schema.

mongoCompass.confirmDangerousOperations.description: Ask for confirmation before dropping databases, collections, indexes or deleting documents.

mongoCompass.queryHistoryLimit.description: Maximum number of entries kept in the query history.

mongoCompass.hideSystemDatabases.description: Hide admin, local and config databases from the explorer.

mongoCompass.showSystemCollections.description: Show system.* collections in the explorer.

mongoCompass.connectionTimeoutMS.description: Server selection timeout used when connecting.

mongoCompass.oidc.deviceAuthFlow.description: Allow the OIDC Device Authorization flow: sign in on any device with a code when the browser cannot reach VS Code (Remote SSH, WSL, containers, Codespaces).

mongoCompass.oidc.redirectURI.description: Local redirect URI for the OIDC Authorization Code flow. It must match the redirect URI registered with your identity provider. Empty uses the MongoDB default, http://localhost:27097/redirect.

mongoCompass.exportBatchSize.description: Batch size used when exporting collections.

mongoCompass.autoPreviewPipeline.description: Automatically re-run the aggregation preview when a stage changes.

mongoCompass.cluster.monitorIntervalSeco.description: How often connected replica sets and sharded clusters are checked for elections, unhealthy members and replication lag (seconds; 0 turns monitoring off).

mongoCompass.cluster.lagWarningSeconds.description: Warn when a secondary falls this many seconds behind its primary.

mongoCompass.cluster.notifications.description: Show notifications for elections, members going down or recovering, and replication lag.

mongoCompass.deployments.refreshInterval.description: How often the Deployments view refreshes node status while it is visible (seconds; 0 disables).

mongoCompass.local.binDir.description: Folder containing mongod and mongos for local-process deployments. Empty uses PATH.

mongoCompass.kubernetes.protectedContext.description: kubectl contexts (wildcards allowed) where every change to a deployment requires typing the context name.

mongoCompass.kubernetes.perconaOperatorV.description: Percona Operator for MongoDB version installed by the extension (also used as crVersion of new clusters).

mongoCompass.kubernetes.communityOperato.description: Helm chart installed for MongoDBCommunity resources (MongoDB Controllers for Kubernetes).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run build
